svg.title: UML Diagram: Class StructuredDataSet in Context

g.text: UML Diagram: Class StructuredDataSet in Context
- The arrows of the inheritance tree are

a.title: • DataSet: Organized collection of data based on keys.
a.xlink:title: • DataSet: Organized collection of data based on keys.

a.title: • Concept: Unit of thought differentiated by characteristics (from the Generic Statistical Information Model version 1.2: https://statswiki.unece.org/display/clickablegsim/Concept).
a.xlink:title: • Concept: Unit of thought differentiated by characteristics (from the Generic Statistical Information Model version 1.2: https://statswiki.unece.org/display/clickablegsim/Concept).

a.title: • PhysicalDataSet: Information needed for understanding the physical structure of data coming from a file or other source.
a.xlink:title: • PhysicalDataSet: Information needed for understanding the physical structure of data coming from a file or other source.

a.title: • CatalogDetails: A set of information useful for attribution, data discovery, and access.
a.xlink:title: • CatalogDetails: A set of information useful for attribution, data discovery, and access.

a.title: • ControlledVocabularyEntry: Allows for unstructured content which may be an entry from an externally maintained controlled vocabulary.If the content is from a controlled vocabulary provide the code value of the entry, as well as a reference to the controlled vocabulary from which the value is taken. a.title: • DataFingerprint: Hash value (digital fingerprint) of the logical or physical representation of data.

a.title: • Identifier: Identifier for objects requiring short- or long-lasting referencing and management.

a.title: • ObjectName: A standard means of expressing a name for a class object. A linguistic signifier. Human understandable name (word, phrase, or mnemonic) that reflects the ISO/IEC 11179-5 naming principles.
